messages:
maria.g: Hey team — first week here! Quick flight plan: need VPN + GitHub org invite + access to a small Dedicated test pool. Also who do I ping for payroll/hardware and for the escalation matrix (oncall routing)? TL;DR: who owns each lane?

alex.k: Welcome! For repo + Slack invites ping @lina.devex. For VPN and Dedicated pool access open an infra ticket and cc @jordan.s. For payroll/hardware see @rebecca.hr.

lina.devex: @maria.g I got you — DMing the onboarding checklist in a sec. For GitHub invites, please fill the access form: https://go/repo-access and include your GitHub handle.

jordan.s: VPN/VPC and group access here — open a ticket in #eng-infra with subject: "infra-access: onboarding <your-name>" and paste your employee ID. I'll add you to the Dedicated-access group.

devops-bot: Ticket created: INFRA-4789 by maria.g (onboarding) — assigned to eng-infra. ETA ~1 business day.

sam.p: For payroll/hardware, ping @rebecca.hr with shipping address + preferred laptop model. I can confirm manager approval if needed.

rebecca.hr: @maria.g Welcome! Sending the welcome survey + hardware form now. Also reminder: new hire orientation is 10am tomorrow in #all-hands — please join.

maria.g: Thanks — one more: where's the escalation matrix for prod incidents? I'm shadowing on-call next week and want to read up.

alex.k: Prod ownership matrix maintained by eng-sre. Start here: https://go/redwood/oncall-matrix. Immediate escalation path: page #eng-oncall, then page the oncall pager; fallback is pinging @jordan.s then me.

lina.devex: I'll add you to the oncall rotation doc and ensure you have read access. Quick access test for environment: ```ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood git@ssh.redwood.com``` — if that fails, paste the error here.

maria.g: Got it. Also: who approves small Dedicated capacity reservations for dev testing?

jordan.s: Capacity approvals are handled by eng-platform -> product infra. For small tests, tag @alex.k with use-case and duration.

alex.k: I can approve up to 2 GPUs for short trials; DM me the details (model, duration, workload). :thumbsup:

lina.devex: Closing the loop — DM me your manager and official start date and I’ll trigger repo invites + slack channels once INFRA-4789 is processed.

maria.g: Thanks everyone — this is super helpful! :rocket:
